caption: The drawing features two renditions of the same object, a shallow, round bowl with a decorated flat handle. On the left side, the bowl is shown from a top-down perspective, revealing its circular interior with concentric shading and a raised center. The handle is attached at the top of the bowl and features an openwork design with a loop and curving, symmetrical elements. On the right side, the bowl is illustrated at an angle, which displays its inner depth and the same ornamental handle, as well as the bowl’s rounded sides. Both objects are rendered in grayscale tones with subtle shading to suggest metallic or ceramic material, set against a light beige background with no additional elements.
title: Pewter Porringer
